book.name: Luka
book.title: Cau amsǝban a nê mala LUKA

content: A ɓè Sabbat, pwari usǝlǝo mala amǝ Yahudi ka, Yesu kutio aban lili a ɓala mala ɓè ɓwamǝgule Farisi. Kara aɓwana tsǝki wi mǝsǝu.
Àkǝ̀ ɓadǝmbi ka ɓeɓwa ndakam, nǝ kwánó tú.
Yesu ɗì amǝ Farisi andǝ amǝ súrǝ̀ Nggurcau ama,

content.text: <<Nggurcau mala Musa eare ama ɓǝà twalban rǝkwana a pwari Sabbat le, ko ɓǝà kǝa twal ɗàng?>>

content: Ban pwalo ateà ɗǝong. Pǝlǝa Yesu tsǝk buì arǝ ɓwabure, twali wi ban rǝkwana, sǝ tasǝi ɓǝ̀ o.

content.text: <<Yan aɓalǝ wun mǝnana ɓǝ̀ muni ko jamnda male kpa a tūli a pwari Sabbat ka, pà nǝ̀ pusǝì a kaurǝa raka?>>

content: Sǝ yia ka ko à kum cau na amur mǝnia ka ɗàng.
Lang Yesu sǝn aɓea abǝri mǝnana à tunǝia a ban li girlina à nǝ̀ nggǝ alta ban-do mǝɓoarne ka, pǝlǝa nea wia mǝnia yì kanicau ka. Bangŋa ama:

content.text: Ɓǝ̀ ɓwa tunǝo a lìli isǝban ngga, kǝa alta buno mǝɓoarne ɗàng, acemǝnana yakǝla à tunǝna ɓeɓwa mǝnana kutio nǝ ɓoarɓwa ka.
Sǝ ɓǝ̀ nda anggo ka, ɓwa mǝnana tunǝ wun kǝm ngga nǝ̀ yia nô ama, <<Lo, nyinggi mǝnia yì ɓwa ka ban.>> Nǝ kǝsǝkya sǝ awu nǝ nyare aban yiu a ban-do mǝnana a nzǝ́mò ka.

Ɓǝà tunǝo a lìli mǝgule ka, kya do a buno mǝnana a nzǝ́mò ka. Ɓwa mǝnana tunǝo ka ɓǝ̀ yiu sǝ ɓǝ̀ yi nô ama, <<Gyajam, lo kya dǝmba.>> Anggo ka a nǝ kum gulo a ban aɓeo abǝri mǝnana à tunǝ wun wunǝia ka.
Mǝnia nda acemǝnana koya ɓwa na mana twal ɓamur rǝì ka, à nǝ̀ nyesǝi ɓà, sǝ ɓwa mǝnana nongsǝ ɓamur rǝì ka, à nǝ̀ gusǝlǝi.

content: Yesu pǝlǝa ne ɓwa mǝnana tunǝban ngga ama:

content.text: Ɓǝ̀ a tunǝban ace ligirlina banɓoarnado ko pakkiɗire ka, ce a tunǝ agyajam mô, ko amǝ'eambo, ko aɓǝla mô, ko aɓeo amǝ murkala amǝ kume ɗàng. Ɓǝ̀ a pa anggo ka, yia ka à nǝ̀ tunǝo gbal a malea, sǝ anggo ka lǝmdǝna ama à mbweno a kunì.
Ɓǝ̀ a nǝ tunǝban ace ligirlina banɓoarnado ka, tunǝ amǝ'tǝ̀r, amǝkusǝu-wuna, agbakǝre, andǝ ante.
Anggo sǝ a nǝ kum tsǝkbu mala Ɓakuli. Acemǝnana à pà nǝ̀ gandǝ mbweo raka, a nǝ nggá kum mbweban mô a pwari mǝnana amǝ'ɓealɓoarna nǝ̀ loapi ɓembe nǝi ka.

content: Kanicau arǝ dapi mala ligirlinabanɓoarnado mǝgule
Lang ɓeɓwa mǝnana atà Yesu aban lili nǝ̀ ok ana ka, ne Yesu ama, <<Ɓwa mǝnana nǝ̀ ligirlina lǐ mǝgule a Domurǝm mala Ɓakuli ka, ndanǝ tsǝkbu!>>

content.text: Ɓè ɓwa ndakam pak girlina banɓoarnado mǝgule. Turkiban arǝ aɓwana pas.
Lang pwari ligirlina kārǝ́na ka, tasǝ guro male ɓǝ̀ kya ne aɓwana mana à tunǝia lǐ ka ama, ɓǝa yiu, ko mana le ka à malǝna pe.
Sǝ yia kat ka à alkita anjar puro. Mǝdǝmba na ama, <<Ən nggǝ loa kur ɓaban, mǝ nǝ ká sǝne. Pà mǝ nǝ bwal ɗang, pakkam munyi.>>
Ɓè ɓwa ka na ama, <<Ən kúr anda-rya lum, ǝn nggǝ um nǝ o a mwamia, pà mǝ nǝ bwal ɗang, ida pàkkam munyi.>>
Ɓè ɓwa na ɗǝm ama, <<Ən loa isǝ ɓwama, pà mǝ nǝ gandǝ ká ɗang.>>

Guro nyare yi ne mǝtala-ɓala male acau mǝno kat. Mǝtala-ɓala ka bumi lúllô, pǝlǝa banggi guro male ama, <<Nyare o amur anjargula andǝ anreɓala, kyane kya tunǝki amǝ'tǝ̀r, amǝ kusǝ-wuna, ante andǝ agbakǝre.>>
Pǝlǝa guro nyare yi ne wi ama, <<Ɓwamǝgule, gir mǝnana a na ce ka à pangŋǝni, sǝ cili ban ndakam.>>
Pǝlǝa mǝtala-ɓala ne guro ama, <<Puro o amur anjargula mǝgulke andǝ amǝkèke, kya ɓuaki arǝ aɓwana ɓǝa yiu, ace mǝnana ɓala mem ɓǝ̀ yi lùmsǝ ka.
Ən nggǝ na wun, aɓwana mǝnana à túrià ban ngga, kǝɓwa pà kàm ateà nǝ̀ ok girlina mem a kúni ɗàng!>>

content: Aɓwabundǝa pas nda ban ká andǝa Yesu, sǝ pǝlǝ rǝì nea wia ama:

content.text: Ɓwa mǝnana kat kǝ earce kpatam, sǝ ginǝ tárrí andǝ ngge, andǝ māmí, andǝ amuni, andǝ amǝ'eambi aburana andǝ amamǝna raka, pà nǝ̀ gandǝ duk mǝkpatam ɗàng. E, ɓwa pà nǝ̀ duk mǝkpatam ɗàng ɓǝ̀ ɓwe ginǝ ce nggearǝ yilǝmi acem raka.
Sǝ ɓǝ̀ ɓwa twal nggun-gangndǝi male yiu atàm raka, pà nǝ̀ gandǝ duk mǝkpatam ɗang.
Yana atà wun mǝnana earce nǝ̀ ɓak ndà-kulí mǝ'dāhre, sǝ pà nǝ̀ do peatu nǝ̀ ɓalbumi nǝ̀ sǝni ko ndanǝ boalo mǝnana nǝ̀ malǝna mǝno yì túró nǝi ka ɗàng?
Ɓǝ̀ pa anggo raka sǝ kwakina tà kusǝɓǎ, sǝ gandǝ masǝlǝe raka, ko yana sǝ sǝni ka, nǝ̀ oali.
À nǝ̀ nggǝ bang ama, <<Mǝnia yì ɓwa ka tita ɓǎ sǝ gandǝ male ɗàng.>>
Ya murǝm nani nǝ asoje á-lum, nǝ̀ ká lwa arǝ ɓe murǝm mǝnana nǝ asoje á-lumi-ɓari ka, sǝ pà nǝ̀ do peatu nǝ̀ ɓalbumi nǝ̀ sǝni ko nǝ̀ gandǝ came a kún ɓi, mǝnana nǝ asoje á-lumi-ɓari ka ɗàng?
Sǝ ɓǝ̀ pà nǝ̀ gandǝi raka, ɓǝ̀ ɓì nda kuko ka, nǝ̀ gbara nǝ̀ turban ɓǝà zǝmba ace gilǝki cau.
Anggo gbal ɓǝ̀ koyan aɓalǝ wun sǝ nying girbunda male kat raka, pà nǝ̀ gandǝ duk mǝkpatam ɗàng.
Tuɓamur ka gìr mǝɓoarne na, sǝ ɓǝ̀ cyauwe male purrínì rǝì ka, mana nǝ̀ tsǝì sǝ nǝ̀ cyàu ɗǝm?
Pà nǝ ɓoaro ko a ɓaban ko a gìgí ɗang; ueo sukkio mǝnana à nǝ̀ sukki ka.
Ɓwa mǝnana ndanǝ kir okban ngga, ɓǝ̀ o!
